audience: companies and accountants that keep their books in Run my Accounts

useCases.title: Find overdue customer invoices
useCases.text: List the invoices with the status overdue. Ask the assistant for the total per customer.

useCases.title: List the open vendor bills
useCases.text: List the vendor invoices and see which ones you still must pay. Read the payments booked against one bill.

useCases.title: Read the trial balance for a period
useCases.text: Get the account balances, with a wildcard for a range of accounts. Add from and to dates for income statement accounts.

useCases.title: Review the transactions of one account
useCases.text: List the ledger transactions of an account for a month. Check them against the chart of accounts.

useCases.title: Match incoming payments to invoices
useCases.text: List the incoming payments that are not processed since a time. Read the payments of one invoice to match them.
